name: ProductQA – Product Questions & Answers for WooCommerce and Multivendor Marketplaces
author: Raihan

sections.description:
Enhance your WooCommerce store with a powerful and user-friendly Product Questions & Answers system. This plugin adds a dedicated Q&A tab to your product pages, creating a direct line of communication between your customers and your product vendors or administrators.

Customers can easily ask questions about products they are interested in, and product authors receive email notifications to respond promptly. All approved questions and their corresponding answers are displayed neatly within the product tab, building a valuable, user-generated FAQ over time. This not only helps individual customers but also provides crucial information for future shoppers, reducing support requests and increasing conversions.

For store owners and multivendor marketplace authors (compatible with Dokan, WCFM, etc.), the plugin provides a centralized dashboard to view and manage all questions. Authors can see questions for their products, while administrators can oversee all Q&A activity across the entire store. The intuitive accordion interface allows for efficient management, ensuring no question goes unanswered.

Features

  • Dedicated Q&A Tab: Adds a clean “Questions & Answers” tab to your WooCommerce product pages.
  • AJAX-Powered Forms: Both question and answer submissions happen instantly without page reloads for a smooth user experience.
  • Author Email Notifications: Automatically notifies the product author via email when a new question is submitted.
  • Customer Email Notifications: Automatically sends an email to the customer once their question has been answered.
  • Centralized Management Dashboard: Use the [productqa_author_questions] shortcode to create a dashboard for authors and admins.
  • Accordion View: Questions on the dashboard are neatly organized in an accordion, grouped by product.
  • New Question Indicators: Products with unanswered questions are highlighted and sorted to the top for easy identification.
  • Admin & Author Roles: Administrators can view and answer all questions, while product authors can only manage questions for their own products.
  • Delete Functionality: Easily delete irrelevant or spam questions directly from the management dashboard.
  • Translation Ready: All frontend and backend strings are fully translatable.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the productqa folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Create a new page (e.g., “My Questions”) and add the shortcode [productqa_author_questions].
  4. That’s it! The “Questions & Answers” tab will now appear on your product pages.
sections.faq:
How do I create the page for authors to answer questions?

Simply create a new page from your WordPress dashboard and place the following shortcode in the content area: [productqa_author_questions]

Can I change the look and feel?

Yes, all frontend elements are styled with CSS classes that you can easily override in your theme’s style.css file. The main classes are prefixed with productqa-.

Does this work with multivendor plugins?

Yes. The plugin checks permissions based on the product author, making it compatible with multivendor solutions where vendors are the authors of their products.
